name: ibis Bangkok Siam
short_description: A 189-room budget ibis steps from National Stadium BTS station in Bangkok's Siam shopping district, sharing its building with the adjacent Mercure Bangkok Siam.
ai_summary: ibis Bangkok Siam is a 189-room economy hotel steps from the National Stadium BTS and Airport Rail Link station, in the same Rama I Road building as the adjacent Mercure Bangkok Siam. All rooms run a compact, uniform 17 square metres with king or twin beds, and guests can pay to use the Mercure's pool and gym. The hotel serves an all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet at The Eight restaurant and sits within walking distance of MBK, Siam Paragon, Siam Discovery, and Jim Thompson House. Reviews consistently praise the unbeatable BTS-adjacent location, clean rooms, and friendly staff, while noting the small room size and dim lighting typical of the ibis economy tier -- this is a distinct property from the separately listed ibis Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi, several kilometres away.

core_facts.address: 927 Rama I Road, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, 10330 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Steps from National Stadium BTS station and the Airport Rail Link
Walking distance to MBK, Siam Paragon, Siam Discovery, and Jim Thompson House
189 clean, contemporary rooms with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and in-room safes
All-you-can-eat breakfast buffet at The Eight, mixing international, Asian, and Thai dishes
Budget price point for a prime central Bangkok shopping-district location
cons: Rooms are a uniform, compact 17 square metres with limited storage space
No on-site pool or gym -- guests must pay a fee to use the adjoining Mercure's facilities
research_highlights: The National Stadium BTS-adjacent location draws consistent, strong praise across TripAdvisor and blog reviews
Accor's official page shows a 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 739 reviews; TripAdvisor shows 4/5 from roughly 2,161 reviews
The hotel shares its building and street address with Mercure Bangkok Siam, mirroring the pairing at the separate ibis/Mercure Ratchathewi properties
research_watchouts: Easily confused with the separately listed ibis Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi, a different property in a different part of Bangkok
Some reviews mention inconsistent water heater temperature and small bathrooms

faqs.question: Is ibis Bangkok Siam the same hotel as ibis Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi?
faqs.answer: No -- these are two distinct Accor properties. ibis Bangkok Siam sits on Rama I Road next to National Stadium BTS station in the Siam shopping district, while ibis Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi is a separate hotel near Ratchathewi BTS station, several kilometres away in a different part of the city.

faqs.question: Does ibis Bangkok Siam have a pool?
faqs.answer: Not on-site. The hotel shares its building with the adjacent Mercure Bangkok Siam, and guests can pay a fee to use the Mercure's rooftop pool and fitness centre, which is a common arrangement between paired ibis and Mercure properties in this Accor portfolio.
